name: MFIT Personal
description: Connect Claude to your MFIT Personal trainer account. Search and review named clients, groups, exercises, workouts, and evaluations; compare a small set of evaluations; and prepare supported client, group, custom-exercise, or workout changes. You can also prepare online evaluation requests and push notifications for one client or one group. Every change or outbound send is previewed first and requires explicit confirmation. Results are intentionally bounded and do not expose full client lists, group rosters, arbitrary exports, billing data, media libraries, or database access.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MFIT Personal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MFIT Personal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mfitpersonal.com.br/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MFIT Personal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MFIT Personal lists 21 MCP tools, including mfit_clients_get, mfit_clients_preview_change, mfit_clients_search, mfit_evaluations_compare, mfit_evaluations_get, mfit_evaluations_list, mfit_evaluations_preview_send, mfit_exercise_taxonomy_list, mfit_exercises_get, mfit_exercises_preview_change, mfit_exercises_search, and mfit_groups_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MFIT Personal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MFIT Personal in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sweat & Tonic, Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, and CheckCells.

_published_faq.name: Does MFIT Personal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MFIT Personal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MFIT Personal is developed by MFIT Personal. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
